content.short: Router Protocol is a cross-chain communication infrastructure enabling seamless asset transfers and messaging between Mantle and 40+ blockchains.
content.description: Router Protocol is a cross-chain infrastructure layer providing a suite of interoperability solutions including the Router Nitro bridge, cross-chain messaging (CCIF), and a liquidity aggregation network. The protocol enables dApps to become natively cross-chain by integrating Router's messaging primitives, allowing smart contracts on Mantle to communicate with and trigger actions on any supported blockchain. Router Protocol underpins multiple cross-chain DeFi applications in the Mantle ecosystem.
content.meta: Router Protocol provides cross-chain communication and bridging infrastructure connecting Mantle to 40+ blockchains. Discover Router Protocol on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
